Read lines incrementally from the offset position\n        // Note: line numbers here are relative to the new content, not the full file\n        for (line_num, line_result) in reader.lines().enumerate() {\n            let line_num = line_num + 1; // 1-indexed for error messages\n            let line = match line_result {\n                Ok(l) => l,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    // Don't spam warnings for incremental read errors at EOF\n                    if e.kind() != std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof {\n                        warn!(\n                            \"Read error at {}:{} (offset {}) - {}\",\n                            source_path.display(),\n                            line_num,\n                            start_offset,\n                            e\n                        );\n                    }\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            if line.trim().is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            match JsonlParser::parse_line(&line, line_num, &context, plugin) {\n                Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    if e.is_skippable() {\n                        // Log at warn level instead of eprintln to respect tracing filters\n                        warn!(\"{}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        return Err(e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>> {\n        // For JSONL with one-file-per-session, the file itself is the session\n        match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => {\n                        // For subagent sessions, include parent directory in session ID\n                        // to maintain hierarchy and avoid collisions\n                        let is_subagent = source_path\n                            .components()\n                            .any(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\");\n\n                        if is_subagent {\n                            // Extract path from \".../<parent>/subagents/<agent>.jsonl\"\n                            // to get \"<parent>/<agent>\"\n                            let components: Vec<_> = source_path.components().collect();\n\n                            if let Some(subagents_idx) =\n                                components.iter().position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                            {\n                                if subagents_idx >= 2 {\n                                    let parent_idx = subagents_idx - 1;\n                                    if let (Some(parent_os), Some(agent_os)) = (\n                                        components.get(parent_idx),\n                                        components.get(subagents_idx + 1),\n                                    ) {\n                                        if let (Some(parent_name), Some(agent_name)) = (\n                                            parent_os.as_os_str().to_str(),\n                                            agent_os.as_os_str().to_str(),\n                                        ) {\n                                            // Get agent name without extension\n                                            let agent_stem = agent_name\n                                                .strip_suffix(\".jsonl\")\n                                                .or_else(|| agent_name.strip_suffix(\".json\"))\n                                                .unwrap_or(agent_name);\n                                            format!(\"{}/{}\", parent_name, agent_stem)\n                                        } else {\n                                            source_path\n                                                .file_stem()\n                                                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                                .to_string()\n                                        }\n                                    } else {\n                                        source_path\n                                            .file_stem()\n                                            .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                            .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                            .to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n                                    source_path\n                                        .file_stem()\n                                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                        .to_string()\n                                }\n                            } else {\n                                source_path\n                                    .file_stem()\n                                    .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                    .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                    .to_string()\n                            }\n                        } else {\n                            source_path\n                                .file_stem()\n                                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                .to_string()\n                        }\n                    }\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(field) => {\n                        // Read first line to extract session ID (handle zst)\n                        match open_file_maybe_zst(source_path) {\n                            Ok(mut reader) => {\n                                let mut first_line = String::new();\n                                if reader.read_line(&mut first_line).is_ok() {\n                                    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&first_line) {\n                                        // Envelope-aware session ID extraction\n                                        // Check if we have envelope config\n                                        let (envelope_json, payload_json) = if let Some(\n                                            ref envelope_cfg,\n                                        ) =\n                                            plugin.source.envelope\n                                        {\n                                            let type_value =\n                                                extract_string(&json, &envelope_cfg.type_field)\n                                                    .unwrap_or_default();\n                                            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n                                            // Only extract if this line has routing\n                                            if routing == \"event\" || routing == \"meta\" {\n                                                let extracted = json\n                                                    .get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field)\n                                                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n                                                        Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n                                                        _ => None,\n                                                    });\n                                                match extracted {\n                                                    Some(payload) => (Some(&json), payload),\n                                                    None => (None, &json),\n                                                }\n                                            } else {\n                                                (None, &json)\n                                            }\n                                        } else {\n                                            (None, &json)\n                                        };\n\n                                        extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                            field,\n                                            payload_json,\n                                            envelope_json,\n                                        )\n                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n                                    } else {\n                                        \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n                                    \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                    }\n                };\n\n                let file_size = std::fs::metadata(source_path)?.len();\n\n                // Detect subagent sessions and extract parent_session_id from directory structure\n                //\n                // Subagent files are at: .../<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n                //\n                // ROOT CAUSE FIX (bead bf-1pkfp):\n                // The previous implementation required:\n                // 1. At least 2 components before \"subagents\" (subagents_idx >= 2)\n                // 2. A \"projects\" directory somewhere before the parent session\n                //\n                // This caused test fixtures and non-standard directory structures to fail\n                // parent_session_id extraction because they didn't match the exact production\n                // layout of ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n                //\n                // THE FIX:\n                // - Removed the \"projects\" directory requirement entirely\n                // - Reduced minimum components before \"subagents\" from 2 to 1\n                // - Directly extract parent session ID as the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n                //\n                // This allows subagent detection to work for both:\n                // - Production paths: ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n                // - Test paths: /tmp/.../sessions/<parent>/subagents/...\n                //\n                let parent_session_id = source_path\n                    .components()\n                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                    .and_then(|subagents_idx| {\n                        // Parent session UUID is the component before \"subagents\"\n                        // We need at least 1 component before \"subagents\": .../<parent-session>/subagents/...\n                        if subagents_idx >= 1 {\n                            let components: Vec<_> = source_path.components().collect();\n\n                            // The parent session is the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n                            let parent_idx = subagents_idx - 1;\n\n                            components\n                                .get(parent_idx)\n                                .and_then(|c| c.as_os_str().to_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n                    session_id,\n                    start_offset: 0,\n                    end_offset: file_size,\n                    metadata: None,\n                    parent_session_id,\n                }])\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // For other detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n                Ok(vec![])\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::parser::FormatParser;\n    use crate::plugin::{\n        LogFormat, Parser, Plugin, PluginMeta, SessionDetection, SessionIdSource,        self\n409\t    }\n410\t\n411\t    #[allow(dead_code)]\n412\t    pub fn with_model(mut self, model: Option<String>) -> Self {\n413\t        self.model = model;\n414\t        self\n415\t    }\n416\t\n417\t    #[allow(dead_code)]\n418\t    pub fn increment_line(&mut self) {\n419\t        self.line_number += 1;\n420\t    }\n421\t}\n422\t\n423\t/// Check if a field name has a caret prefix (^)\n424\t///\n425\t/// Returns true if the field name starts with `^`, false otherwise.\n426\t/// Handles empty strings gracefully (returns false).\n427\t///\n428\t/// # Examples\n429\t/// ```\n430\t/// assert!(has_caret_prefix(\"^foo\"));\n431\t/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"foo\"));\n432\t/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"bar^baz\"));\n433\t/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"\"));\n434\t/// ```\n435\tpub fn has_caret_prefix(field_name: &str) -> bool {\n436\t    field_name.starts_with('^')\n437\t}\n438\t\n439\t/// Extract a nested field from JSON using dot notation\n440\tpub fn extract_field(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<Value> {\n441\t    if path.is_empty() {\n442\t        return None;\n443\t    }\n444\t\n445\t    let mut current = value;\n446\t    for part in path.split('.') {\n447\t        // Handle array indexing like parts[0]\n448\t        if let Some(bracket_pos) = part.find('[') {\n449\t            let key = &part[..bracket_pos];\n450\t            let index_str = &part[bracket_pos + 1..part.len() - 1];\n451\t            let index: usize = index_str.parse().ok()?;\n452\t\n453\t            current = current.get(key)?.get(index)?;\n454\t        } else {\n455\t            current = current.get(part)?;\n456\t        }\n457\t    }\n458\t    Some(current.clone())\n459\t}\n460\t\n461\t/// Extract a string field from JSON\n462\tpub fn extract_string(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<String> {\n463\t    let field = extract_field(value, path)?;\n464\t    match field {\n465\t        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n466\t        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n467\t        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n468\t        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n469\t        _ => None,\n470\t    }\n471\t}\n472\t\n473\t/// Parse timestamp from various formats\n474\tpub fn parse_timestamp(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n475\t    let ts_str = extract_string(value, path)\n476\t        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n477\t\n478\t    // Try ISO 8601 first\n479\t    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n480\t        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n481\t    }\n482\t\n483\t    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n484\t    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n485\t        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n486\t            // Milliseconds\n487\t            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n488\t        } else {\n489\t            // Seconds\n490\t            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n491\t        };\n492\t        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n493\t    }\n494\t\n495\t    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n496\t    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n497\t        return Ok(dt);\n498\t    }\n499\t\n500\t    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n501\t        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n502\t        ts_str\n503\t    )))\n504\t}\n505\t\n506\t/// Extract a field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n507\t///\n508\t/// **Envelope-first with payload fallback for caret-prefixed paths:**\n509\t/// - If path starts with `^`, try envelope first (remove `^` prefix)\n510\t/// - If envelope is None OR field not found in envelope, fallback to payload\n511\t/// - Otherwise, extract from payload only\n512\t///\n513\t/// **Resolution order for `^field`:**\n514\t/// 1. Try `envelope.field` (if envelope exists)\n515\t/// 2. Fallback to `payload.field` (if envelope missing or field not found)\n516\t/// 3. Return None (if both fail)\n517\t///\n518\t/// **Resolution order for `field` (no caret):**\n519\t/// - Extract from `payload.field` only\n520\t///\n521\t/// Supports dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `^outer.ts` or `user.role`)\n522\t/// and array indexing (e.g., `items[0].name`).\n523\tpub fn extract_with_envelope(\n524\t    path: &str,\n525\t    payload: &Value,\n526\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n527\t) -> Option<Value> {\n528\t    if has_caret_prefix(path) {\n529\t        // Strip the caret prefix\n530\t        if let Some(envelope_path) = path.strip_prefix('^') {\n531\t            // Try envelope first\n532\t            if let Some(env) = envelope {\n533\t                if let Some(value) = extract_field(env, envelope_path) {\n534\t                    return Some(value); // Found in envelope\n535\t                }\n536\t            }\n537\t            // Fallback to payload (using path without ^)\n538\t            extract_field(payload, envelope_path)\n539\t        } else {\n540\t            // Should not happen due to starts_with check, but handle defensively\n541\t            None\n542\t        }\n543\t    } else {\n544\t        // No caret prefix - extract from payload only\n545\t        extract_field(payload, path)\n546\t    }\n547\t}\n548\t\n549\t/// Extract a string field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n550\t///\n551\t/// Wrapper around `extract_with_envelope` that converts the raw `Value` to a string,\n552\t/// following the same coercion rules as `extract_string` (String, Number, Bool, Null).\n553\tpub fn extract_string_with_envelope(\n554\t    path: &str,\n555\t    payload: &Value,\n556\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n557\t) -> Option<String> {\n558\t    let value = extract_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)?;\n559\t    match value {\n560\t        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n561\t        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n562\t        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n563\t        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n564\t        Value::Array(arr) => {\n565\t            // Handle content arrays (e.g., Claude Code format with text blocks and tool calls)\n566\t            // Extract text from all text blocks in the array\n567\t            let text_parts: Vec<String> = arr\n568\t                .iter()\n569\t                .filter_map(|item| {\n570\t                    if let Some(obj) = item.as_object() {\n571\t                        // Check for text blocks: {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"...\"}\n572\t                        if obj.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n573\t                            return obj\n574\t                                .get(\"text\")\n575\t                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n576\t                                .map(|s| s.to_string());\n577\t                        }\n578\t                    }\n579\t                    None\n580\t                })\n581\t                .collect();\n582\t            if text_parts.is_empty() {\n583\t                None\n584\t            } else {\n585\t                Some(text_parts.join(\" \"))\n586\t            }\n587\t        }\n588\t        _ => None,\n589\t    }\n590\t}\n591\t\n592\t/// Parse a timestamp from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n593\t///\n594\t/// Wrapper around `extract_string_with_envelope` that parses the extracted string\n595\t/// as a timestamp. Supports ISO 8601, Unix epoch (seconds/milliseconds), and\n596\t/// UTC-naive formats.\n597\tpub fn parse_timestamp_with_envelope(\n598\t    path: &str,\n599\t    payload: &Value,\n600\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n601\t) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n602\t    let ts_str = extract_string_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)\n603\t        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n604\t\n605\t    // Try ISO 8601 first\n606\t    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n607\t        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n608\t    }\n609\t\n610\t    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n611\t    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n612\t        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n613\t            // Milliseconds\n614\t            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n615\t        } else {\n616\t            // Seconds\n617\t            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n618\t        };\n619\t        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n620\t    }\n621\t\n622\t    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n623\t    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n624\t        return Ok(dt);\n625\t    }\n626\t\n627\t    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n628\t        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n629\t        ts_str\n630\t    )))\n631\t}\n632\t\n633\t/// Base trait for all format parsers\n634\tpub trait FormatParser {\n635\t    /// Parse events from the source\n636\t    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>>;\n637\t\n638\t    /// Parse events from the source, starting from a given byte offset for incremental parsing.\n639\t    ///\n640\t    /// For formats that support incremental parsing (JSONL, append-only logs), this allows\n641\t    /// the parser to skip already-processed content and only parse new data.\n642\t    ///\n643\t    /// # Arguments\n644\t    ///\n645\t    /// * `source_path` - Path to the source file\n646\t    /// * `plugin` - Plugin configuration for this source\n647\t    /// * `start_offset` - Byte offset to start reading from (0 for errors)\n653\t    fn parse_incremental(\n654\t        &self,\n655\t        source_path: &Path,\n656\t        plugin: &Plugin,\n657\t        start_offset: u64,\n658\t    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n659\t        // Default implementation falls back to full parse\n660\t        let _ = start_offset; // Suppress unused warning\n661\t        self.parse(source_path, plugin)\n662\t    }\n663\t\n664\t    /// Detect session boundaries in the source\n665\t    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>>;\n666\t}\n667\t\n668\t/// The format varies by import type:\n///\n/// - **For `use` statements**: Full module path being imported (e.g., `\"std::collections::HashMap\"`,\n///   `\"crate::module::Item\"`, `\"super::ParentModule\"`)\n/// - **For `extern crate`**: The crate name (e.g., `\"serde\"`, `\"tokio\"`)\n/// - **For `mod`**: The module name (e.g., `\"foo\"`, `\"bar\"`)\n///\n/// **Constraints:**\n/// - Non-empty string (cannot be `\"\"`)\n/// - Contains only valid Rust identifier characters and path separators (`::`)\n/// - Case-sensitive (matches Rust's rules)\n///\n/// **Usage in practice:**\n/// ```rust\n/// use agentscribe::parser::{Import, ImportType};\n///\n/// // Standard library import\n/// let std_import = Import::new(\"std::collections::HashMap\".to_string(), ImportType::Use, 5);\n///\n/// // Crate-relative import\n/// let crate_import = Import::new(\"crate::module::Item\".to_string(), ImportType::Use, 10);\n///\n/// // External crate\n/// let extern_import = Import::new(\"serde\".to_string(), ImportType::ExternCrate, 1);\n/// ```\n///\n/// ## `import_type: ImportType`\n///\n/// The type classification of the import statement. line_number: 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    pub fn with_project(mut self, project: Option<String>) -> Self {\n        self.project = project;\n        self\n    }\n\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    pub fn with_model(mut self, model: Option<String>) -> Self {\n        self.model = model;\n        self\n    }\n\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    pub fn increment_line(&mut self) {\n        self.line_number += 1;\n    }\n}\n\n/// Check if a field name has a caret prefix (^)\n///\n/// Returns true if the field name starts with `^`, false otherwise.\n/// Handles empty strings gracefully (returns false).\n///\n/// # Examples\n/// ```\n/// assert!(has_caret_prefix(\"^foo\"));\n/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"foo\"));\n/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"bar^baz\"));\n/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"\"));\n/// ```\npub fn has_caret_prefix(field_name: &str) -> bool {\n    field_name.starts_with('^')\n}\n\n/// Extract a nested field from JSON using dot notation\npub fn extract_field(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<Value> {\n    if path.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let mut current = value;\n    for part in path.split('.') {\n        // Handle array indexing like parts[0]\n        if let Some(bracket_pos) = part.find('[') {\n            let key = &part[..bracket_pos];\n            let index_str = &part[bracket_pos + 1..part.len() - 1];\n            let index: usize = index_str.parse().ok()?;\n\n            current = current.get(key)?.get(index)?;\n        } else {\n            current = current.get(part)?;\n        }\n    }\n    Some(current.clone())\n}\n\n/// Extract a string field from JSON\npub fn extract_string(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let field = extract_field(value, path)?;\n    match field {\n        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse timestamp from various formats\npub fn parse_timestamp(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let ts_str = extract_string(value, path)\n        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n            // Milliseconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n        } else {\n            // Seconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n        };\n        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n        return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Extract a field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// **Envelope-first with payload fallback for caret-prefixed paths:**\n/// - If path starts with `^`, try envelope first (remove `^` prefix)\n/// - If envelope is None OR field not found in envelope, fallback to payload\n/// - Otherwise, extract from payload only\n///\n/// **Resolution order for `^field`:**\n/// 1. Try `envelope.field` (if envelope exists)\n/// 2. Fallback to `payload.field` (if envelope missing or field not found)\n/// 3. Return None (if both fail)\n///\n/// **Resolution order for `field` (no caret):**\n/// - Extract from `payload.field` only\n///\n/// Supports dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `^outer.ts` or `user.role`)\n/// and array indexing (e.g., `items[0].name`).\npub fn extract_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<Value> {\n    if has_caret_prefix(path) {\n        // Strip the caret prefix\n        if let Some(envelope_path) = path.strip_prefix('^') {\n            // Try envelope first\n            if let Some(env) = envelope {\n                if let Some(value) = extract_field(env, envelope_path) {\n                    return Some(value); // Found in envelope\n                }\n            }\n            // Fallback to payload (using path without ^)\n            extract_field(payload, envelope_path)\n        } else {\n            // Should not happen due to starts_with check, but handle defensively\n            None\n        }\n    } else {\n        // No caret prefix - extract from payload only\n        extract_field(payload, path)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Extract a string field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_with_envelope` that converts the raw `Value` to a string,\n/// following the same coercion rules as `extract_string` (String, Number, Bool, Null).\npub fn extract_string_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<String> {\n    let value = extract_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)?;\n    match value {\n        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n        Value::Array(arr) => {\n            // Handle content arrays (e.g., Claude Code format with text blocks and tool calls)\n            // Extract text from all text blocks in the array\n            let text_parts: Vec<String> = arr\n                .iter()\n                .filter_map(|item| {\n                    if let Some(obj) = item.as_object() {\n                        // Check for text blocks: {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"...\"}\n                        if obj.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n                            return obj\n                                .get(\"text\")\n                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string());\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None\n                })\n                .collect();\n            if text_parts.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n                Some(text_parts.join(\" \"))\n            }\n        }\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse a timestamp from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_string_with_envelope` that parses the extracted string\n/// as a timestamp. Supports ISO 8601, Unix epoch (seconds/milliseconds), and\n/// UTC-naive formats.\npub fn parse_timestamp_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let ts_str = extract_string_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)\n        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n            // Milliseconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n        } else {\n            // Seconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n        };\n        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n        return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Base trait for all format parsers\npub trait FormatParser {\n    /// Parse events from the source\n    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>>;\n\n    /// Parse events from the source, starting from a given byte offset for incremental parsing.\n    ///\n    /// For formats that support incremental parsing (JSONL, append-only logs), this allows\n    /// the parser to skip already-processed content and only parse new data.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `source_path` - Path to the source file\n    /// * `plugin` - Plugin configuration for this source\n    /// * `start_offset` - Byte offset to start reading from (0 for full parse)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// - `Ok(events)` - Vector of parsed events\n    /// - `Err(_)` - Parse error (check `is_skippable()` for non-fatal errors)\n    fn parse_incremental(\n        &self,\n        source_path: &Path,\n        plugin: &Plugin,\n        start_offset: u64,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        // Default implementation falls back to full parse\n        let _ = start_offset; // Suppress unused warning\n        self.parse(source_path, plugin)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect session boundaries in the source\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>>;\n}\n\n/// Information about a detected session\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n#[allow(dead_code)]\npub struct SessionInfo {\n    pub session_id: String,\n    pub start_offset: u64,\n    pub end_offset: u64,\n    pub metadata: Option<Value>,\n    /// Parent session ID (populated for subagent sessions where this session\n    /// is a child of another session)\n    pub parent_session_id: Option<String>,\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde_json::json;\n\n    // Tests for Import and ImportType types\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_import_type_creation() {\n
